turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can I take a passport photo at home or will they reject it?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Many countries accept home photos if you meet the rules. Check your passport office's list, but the usual ones are plain light background, even lighting and a neutral face.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Usually, yes. Mouth closed, eyes open, no glasses, looking straight at the camera.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Wait a second, that doesn't sound right.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Let me double-check. I'd still stand by it, but tell me what you heard.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My walls are kind of beige.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Beige can fail. Stand in front of a white door or tape a white sheet up, and face a window so there are no shadows behind you.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Better than a selfie, actually. Have him stand about a metre and a half away at your eye level, so your face isn't distorted.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay. Nothing worse than looking like a criminal for ten years.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Even with no smile, a relaxed face helps. Take a few and pick the calmest one.
